facts.fact: Kenya is on PAPSS: the central bank joined in September 2023, KCB went live in March 2025 and Pesalink plugged into PAPSS in February 2026, per tech-ish.
Through the Pesalink link to PAPSS, mobile money wallets in Kenya became a valid destination for inbound African payments, and Pesalink is piloted for termination of PAPSS transactions, per tech-ish.
